notes: Full backup keeps the whole car again: the SVT read from the car is now saved in the backup (it was left out), the fault memory is read through E-Sys's own connection when the gateway lets only one program in, and "Read from the car first" is ticked when you open the window while connected. E-Sys's own Save, Ctrl+S and "save the changes?" in the SVT editor and FDL-Editor now write a copy with MODIFIED in its name and never overwrite the file read from the car; a changed BMW-signed coding file is still refused by Save and code. The battery and ignition plates keep reading after you connect the same car again. Code several says what to do when a car's coding was not read yet, and its messages are no longer cut off. Coding history shows each coding file of a module and names a file two modules share. Car reports say when faults were read through E-Sys's connection.
